Theme

Body, health & movement

chlorine noun

also chlorinated, chlorinated water

modern

M-O s.v. chlorine

chlōrium, chlōriī n.

noun, second declension

A modern coinage; Traupman has none.

Examples

  • aqua chlōrāta

    chlorinated watercomposed

  • aqua sine chlōriō

    water without chlorinecomposed

  • Nōlō tē nimis diū in aquā chlōrātā manēre.

    I don’t want you staying too long in the chlorinated water.composed

See also swimming pool.

SourcesMorgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. chlorine.

The example sentences marked “composed” are ours.
